description: A dynamic plyometric exercise transitioning from a bodyweight squat into a maximal vertical jump.
setup: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward or slightly out, and arms relaxed at your sides.
steps: Lower into a quarter to half squat while swinging arms back.
Explode upward through ankles, knees, and hips, swinging arms toward the ceiling.
Extend fully at the peak of the jump with toes pointed downward.
Land softly through toes and midfoot, immediately absorbing into the next squat descent.
cues: Explode vertically with triple extension at hips, knees, and ankles
Absorb your landing silently through hips and knees

mistakes.mistake: Landing with straight knees and flat feet
mistakes.fix: Cushion impact by rolling from toe to heel into a bent-knee squat

mistakes.mistake: Knees caving inward on takeoff or landing
mistakes.fix: Track knees actively outward over toes throughout the movement

rep_standard: Begins from squat depth, fully leaves the ground with feet extended, and lands softly directly into the next squat cushion.
